properties.name: bluetape4k.aws.cloudwatch.micrometer.registry.enabled
properties.description: Opt in to the scheduled native Micrometer CloudWatch exporter.

properties.name: bluetape4k.aws.cloudwatch.micrometer.registry.namespace
properties.description: CloudWatch namespace for the native registry; falls back to cloudwatch.namespace.

properties.name: bluetape4k.aws.cloudwatch.micrometer.registry.batch-size
properties.description: Maximum metric datum count per PutMetricData request.

properties.name: bluetape4k.aws.cloudwatch.micrometer.registry.read-timeout
properties.description: Maximum wait for one CloudWatch PutMetricData future.

properties.name: bluetape4k.aws.cloudwatch.micrometer.registry.common-tags
properties.description: Low-cardinality tags applied only to the native registry meters.

properties.name: bluetape4k.aws.cloudwatch.micrometer.registry.filters.includes
properties.description: Optional meter-name prefixes to allow. An empty list allows all meters.

properties.name: bluetape4k.aws.cloudwatch.micrometer.registry.filters.excludes
properties.description: Meter-name prefixes to deny after include filtering.
